title: Union Budget total expenditure
definition: Total expenditure of the Government of India combining revenue expenditure and capital expenditure across each financial year.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
sources.title: Budget at a Glance 2026-2027

points.evidence: Page 1, Budget at a Glance table, row 'Total Expenditure (10+13)': FY 2024-25 (Actuals) is 4652867 crore INR.
Page 1, Budget at a Glance table, row 'Total Expenditure (10+13)': FY 2025-26 (Revised Estimates) is 4964842 crore INR.
points.estimate_method: Ministry of Finance Revised Estimates for FY 2025-26.

points.evidence: Page 1, Budget at a Glance table, row 'Total Expenditure (10+13)': FY 2026-27 (Budget Estimates) is 5347315 crore INR.
points.estimate_method: Ministry of Finance Budget Estimates for FY 2026-27.
